decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication sits close to the firm's established offer for machine-tool users, and the firm is expanding and investing, so it has slack to carry the product; the missing website data for 2020-2021 gives no signal of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's core filtration platform and shares its modular components, manufacturing and service, so in a growing industry its results likely meet aspirations and dropping it would free few resources.

Gravity band filters are a staple of the firm's established coolant filtration offer, so the product fits the one-stop modular strategy and the expanding firm has no performance gap pushing it to cut the product.
